title: Evolve Detent
description: A rotary knob that keeps the physics of a real dial — flick it and it spins on its own momentum, decelerating step by step until it clicks to rest. A ring of ticks lights up as it climbs, read out below in tabular figures.
intent: Pushes the motion of the loved tactile readout further with real momentum and inertia, so the knob feels like a weighted physical object rather than a 1:1 drag surface.
